args.title: Summary: Ironbark warehouse automation posts (main + subscriber companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion (https://insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion, accessed with team code SUB-2718):

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in warehouse pick rates in 2026.
- Integration work took twice as long as originally planned, tempering the rollout timeline.
- Per the companion piece, the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks rather than raw speed gains.
